user_query: trass gmail with terms gianfranco australia AU within last 4 months

intent.goal: find emails in Trass Gmail containing mentions of Gianfranco and Australia/AU

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%gianfranco%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%gianfranco%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%gianfranco%'
    OR LOWER(g.sender_name) LIKE '%gianfranco%'
)
AND (
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%australia%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%australia%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%australia%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%au%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%au%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%au%'
)
AND (
    u.created_time >= date('now', '-4 months')
    OR g.email_date >= date('now', '-4 months')
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
